{{Quote|I'll get out the lenses, you assemble the scope, and we can reminisce about the Valley of the Deathdroids&hellip;|[[Ngani Zho]], to [[Theron Shan]]|<ref name="TLS3">[[The Old Republic — The Lost Suns 3|''The Old Republic — The Lost Suns'' 3]]</ref>}}
The '''Valley of the Deathdroids''' was a location set somewhere in the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. At some point, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ngani Zho]] and [[Theron Shan]] shared an adventure there.
